paper_metadata.title: Benchmarking of Quantum and Classical Computing in Large-Scale Dynamic Portfolio Optimization Under Market Frictions

experiments.description: Quantum-ready QUBO benchmark on a medium-sized dynamic portfolio optimization instance with 200 stocks over 10 trading days, evaluated across multiple risk-aversion settings q using ABS2/qoqo and compared against Gurobi BQP baselines.

algorithm.variant: ABS2 on qoqo solver for QUBO portfolio optimization
algorithm.convergence_criteria: time limit 3600 s or stopping criterion of ABS2 (e.g., convergence/max iterations/time limit)

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Binary variables x_{i,t} for asset positions over time, plus slack binaries y_{c,t} and s_{b,t}; total QUBO size reported as 12,100 variables for n=200, T=10, k=3, B=60, C=10.
problem_formulation.objective_function: Minimize sum_t [ q * sum_{i,j} p_{i,t} x_{i,t} sigma_{ij,t} x_{j,t} p_{j,t} - sum_i (p_{i,t+1}-p_{i,t}) x_{i,t} - delta * sum_i p_{i,t}(x_{i,t-1}+x_{i,t}-2x_{i,t-1}x_{i,t}) - rho_c u * sum_c 2^c y_{c,t} + rho_s * sum_{i in S} p_{i,t} x_{i,t} + delta * sum_i p_{i,T} x_{i,T} ] + P * sum_t [ (C - sum_i tau_i x_{i,t} - sum_c 2^c y_{c,t})^2 + (B - sum_i x_{i,t} - sum_b 2^b s_{b,t})^2 ]
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Quadratic penalty terms for capital and asset-count constraints; short selling handled via tau_i in the cash constraint; transaction costs and liquidation costs included directly in the objective.
problem_formulation.problem_hamiltonian: QUBO mapped to Ising Hamiltonian via x_i = (s_i + 1)/2

problem_instance.description: Top 200 S&P 500 market-cap stocks over 10 trading days (two weeks), with short selling, transaction costs, and path-dependent cash constraints.

convergence_data.loss_curve_shape: objective value convergence reported over time

speedup_claims.factor: ABS2 converges faster to good solutions for harder q settings (e.g., ~71 s for q=0.0005 and ~35 s for q=0.001 in text discussion)
speedup_claims.conditions: medium-sized instance n=200, T=10; challenging risk-aversion settings q=0.0005 and q=0.001
speedup_claims.caveats: Gurobi can achieve slightly better final objective values given longer time limits; ABS2 is faster to a good solution, not necessarily to the best proven bound.

experiments.description: Quantum-ready QUBO benchmark on a larger dynamic portfolio optimization instance with 499 stocks over 15 trading days, evaluated across multiple risk-aversion settings q using ABS2/qoqo and compared against Gurobi BQP baselines.

algorithm.variant: ABS2 on qoqo solver for QUBO portfolio optimization
algorithm.convergence_criteria: time limit 3600 s or stopping criterion of ABS2 (e.g., convergence/max iterations/time limit)

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Binary variables x_{i,t} for asset positions over time, plus slack binaries y_{c,t} and s_{b,t}; total QUBO size reported as 45,060 variables for n=499, T=15, k=3, B=60, C=10.
problem_formulation.objective_function: Minimize sum_t [ q * sum_{i,j} p_{i,t} x_{i,t} sigma_{ij,t} x_{j,t} p_{j,t} - sum_i (p_{i,t+1}-p_{i,t}) x_{i,t} - delta * sum_i p_{i,t}(x_{i,t-1}+x_{i,t}-2x_{i,t-1}x_{i,t}) - rho_c u * sum_c 2^c y_{c,t} + rho_s * sum_{i in S} p_{i,t} x_{i,t} + delta * sum_i p_{i,T} x_{i,T} ] + P * sum_t [ (C - sum_i tau_i x_{i,t} - sum_c 2^c y_{c,t})^2 + (B - sum_i x_{i,t} - sum_b 2^b s_{b,t})^2 ]
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Quadratic penalty terms for capital and asset-count constraints; short selling handled via tau_i in the cash constraint; transaction costs and liquidation costs included directly in the objective.
problem_formulation.problem_hamiltonian: QUBO mapped to Ising Hamiltonian via x_i = (s_i + 1)/2

problem_instance.description: All 499 S&P 500 stocks over 15 trading days (three weeks), with short selling, transaction costs, and path-dependent cash constraints.

convergence_data.loss_curve_shape: objective value convergence reported over time

speedup_claims.factor: ABS2 reaches good solutions faster in early stages; at 120 s it often matches or beats BQP objective values, and at q=0.0005/q=0.001 it stabilizes much earlier than Gurobi
speedup_claims.conditions: large instance n=499, T=15; especially q=0.0005 and q=0.001; time limits 120-3600 s
speedup_claims.caveats: Gurobi can still achieve better final objective values with longer runtime; ABS2 is not shown to dominate at all time limits.

experiments.description: Variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) framework described for QUBO-to-Hamiltonian portfolio optimization, implemented in IBM Qiskit as a quantum-ready method; the paper provides the algorithmic setup but no separate numerical VQE benchmark results.

algorithm.convergence_criteria: optimizer minimizes expectation value until energy converges to a minimum

problem_formulation.encoding_details: QUBO converted to Ising Hamiltonian; number of qubits equals number of binary variables in the QUBO instance.
problem_formulation.objective_function: Minimize expectation value E(θ)=⟨ψ(θ)|H|ψ(θ)⟩ where H is the Hamiltonian derived from the QUBO.
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Not specified beyond QUBO formulation and penalty-based constraints in the underlying portfolio model.

problem_instance.description: Generic QUBO portfolio optimization instance; no separate VQE numerical experiment instance is reported.

implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Convert optimized parameters θopt back to QUBO solution xQUBO

experiments.description: Quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) is discussed as a quantum-ready method for the same QUBO portfolio optimization problem, but the paper does not report a separate executed QAOA benchmark.

algorithm.convergence_criteria: theoretically sufficient steps should yield a good or optimal solution; no empirical stopping rule reported

problem_formulation.encoding_details: QUBO mapped to Ising model with x_i=(s_i+1)/2; QAOA acts on the Ising Hamiltonian.
problem_formulation.objective_function: QUBO objective mapped to Ising energy F(s)=sum_i h_i s_i + sum_{i<j} J_{ij} s_i s_j.
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Not specified beyond the QUBO penalty formulation.
problem_formulation.problem_hamiltonian: Ising Hamiltonian with linear coefficients h_i and couplings J_ij

problem_instance.description: Generic QUBO portfolio optimization instance; no separate QAOA numerical benchmark is reported.

experiments.description: Quantum annealing / hybrid quantum optimization is discussed for the QUBO portfolio benchmark, with D-Wave Advantage and D-Wave Hybrid mentioned as applicable platforms; the paper does not report a separate standalone D-Wave numerical experiment in the provided text.

algorithm.variant: D-Wave Advantage / D-Wave Hybrid for QUBO
algorithm.convergence_criteria: adiabatic evolution to final time T; no empirical stopping rule reported
algorithm.parameter_initialization: Prepare ground state of driver Hamiltonian

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Binary QUBO variables mapped to Ising spins for annealing; logical qubits correspond to binary variables.
problem_formulation.objective_function: QUBO portfolio objective with risk, profit, transaction costs, short-selling costs, liquidation costs, and quadratic penalties for capital and asset-count constraints.
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Penalty terms in QUBO; annealing solves the resulting Ising Hamiltonian.

problem_instance.description: Generic QUBO portfolio optimization benchmark intended for D-Wave annealing/hybrid execution; no separate D-Wave run details are reported in the text.
